text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good work, Trainer! —Fufu, I guess 
I've gotten used to calling you that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, you've become such a 
splendid Trainer. Fufu, time really flies 
by in a flash...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a crybaby anymore, you know! I've 
done plenty of training and studying!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You studied a lot too, didn't you? Yeah... 
I know. I've been watching you all this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep doing our best together... from 
here on out too! And one day—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It'd be wonderful if we could look back 
and reminisce about these times together 
in the future!
